_comment: Maps each top-level corpus folder to a display label and a role. Roles: 'current' (our active agreements), 'benchmark' (competitor/market references, not live contracts), 'reference' (SOPs/domain docs). Adding a new folder is optional — if it is not listed here, its role is inferred from the folder name and its label is title-cased. Edit this file, not the code, when the corpus structure changes.

competitor_contracts.label: MARKET REFERENCE (benchmark only — not a current agreement)
